exposure: fetal head circumference (HC) measured by transabdominal ultrasonography
estimated fetal weight (EFW) measured by transabdominal ultrasonography
cohort: 200 spontaneously parturient primiparous women aged 20-30 years were enrolled at a teaching hospital in Cairo, Egypt.
finding: Intrapartum fetal head circumference (HC) of 36.8 cm or more and estimated fetal weight (EFW) of 3920 g or more were significantly associated with an increased risk of operative delivery.
mod_finding: Intrapartum HC and EFW were identified as good predictors of operative delivery, with higher measurements correlating with an increased risk of operative birth.
